description: In a tournament with n teams, teams are paired: if even, n/2 matches with n/2 teams advancing; if odd, (n-1)/2 matches with (n-1)/2+1 teams advancing. Return the total number of matches played until one winner remains.
examples:
Input: n = 7
Output: 6
Explanation: 3 matches (4 advance) -> 2 matches (2 advance) -> 1 match. Total = 6.
intuition: Every match eliminates exactly one team. To go from n teams down to 1 winner, you must eliminate n-1 teams. So regardless of how the bracket works, the answer is always n-1.
approach: Each match eliminates exactly one team. To go from n teams to 1 winner, exactly n-1 teams must be eliminated, so exactly n-1 matches are played.
jsWalkthrough:

We need 1 winner, so 6 teams must be eliminated.

Answer = 7 - 1 = 6
